system.description:
Consolidates the Assassin, Corporate Agent, Enforcer, Pathfinder, and Master Privateer prestige classes. Grants access to the Assassin, Corporate Power, Enforcement, Infamy, Leadership, Pathfinder, Piracy, Privateer, and Spy talent trees.

At 1st level, chooses one of Create Cover, Executive Leadership, Targeted Suspect, or Veteran Privateer as a free class ability. The others may be taken as talents.
